notes: segments[] use the exact src/levels.js / track.js format and can be passed straight to buildTrack(def, gravity). All other fields are gameplay metadata; fields marked implemented:false need new code. Generated by design/gen/build_levels.mjs using the engine's own buildTrack.

physics.loopEntry: v_entry_min = sqrt(5 g r) (energy: v_top^2 = v_entry^2 - 4 g r, need v_top >= sqrt(g r))
physics.gapClear: v_min = sqrt(g x^2 / (2 cos^2 a (x tan a + drop))) — identical to track.js gap len solver

levels.name: Tranquility Run
levels.blurb: One-sixth gravity. Float over craters and enjoy the view of Earth.
